name: S&W Wire Co
old_description: Textile covering consisting of pure fiberglass yarn, which is wrapped, treated, and then heat fused to the underlying conductor. Can be constructed with a single layer or double layer of glass yarn.
about:
S&W Wire Company operates from Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1988 to meet demand for fast-turnaround production of glass- and Kapton-insulated magnet wire. The company remains privately held; founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm manufactures a range of magnet wire products, including enameled wire, polyglass-insulated wire (pure fiberglass yarn wrapped, treated, and heat-fused to the conductor in single or double layers), and seamless hollow conductor tubing. It also provides wire testing services for specification and batch uniformity, custom stocking programs aligned with customer supply-chain schedules, and a respooling service that sells exact lengths without requiring full-reel purchases. Inventory exceeds 150,000 pounds across more than 200 sizes, backed by a computerized link to North America’s largest wire inventories.

S&W Wire serves magnet-wire buyers of all sizes, from small prototype orders to high-volume production runs, offering both bare and insulated wire in round, square, and rectangular profiles. Customers span industries that rely on magnet wire for motors, transformers, and generators, though the company does not publicly list specific sectors.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround, no minimum order quantities, competitive pricing on scheduled lead-time orders, and daily-updated online inventory with instant quote capability. Its Wire On Demand suite bundles exact-length cutting, stocking programs, and testing to reduce customer lead times and inventory costs.
